title: L&D Programme Coordinator (f/m/d)
description:
Coordinate learning programmes for our global workforce.

What you'll do
- Plan and schedule trainings and track registrations
- Maintain the course catalogue and learner records in the LMS
- Prepare reports on completion and budgets

What you bring
- Two years of experience in training coordination or HR operations
- LMS experience and strong organisational skills
- Good English
